results.title: Friends: the old reader's full page
results.checks: Signed in: Profile → Friends opens a full page (the reading area gives way) with ← back to Profile: Friends (each with Remove), Add a friend (Send request; your friend link with Copy and Email it; your user ID with Copy) and, when there are any, Friend requests (Accept, Decline) and Sent requests (Cancel). Send request opens your Home's add-a-contact page for exactly that name; Remove asks first (Remove friend?) and then opens your Home's page to remove exactly that friend. (The test records the Home address instead of opening it, so nothing is signed)
results.note: full page with Friend requests · Friends · Add a friend; Send request opened the Home for that name; Remove asked first, then opened the Home to remove exactly that friend; ← back to Profile

results.title: Add a friend answers at once
results.checks: Signed in as Seed Reader: Add a friend with your own name says 'That's your own account.', and with a friend's name 'You're already friends.' — no Home window opens for either
results.note: own name: That's your own account; 'ruth.me': You're already friends; no Home window

results.title: Tap a friend: their profile
results.checks: Signed in as Seed Reader, tapping a friend in Friends opens Profile with their picture and name, and their description or 'This person hasn't set up their profile yet.'; Close shuts it
results.note: 'ezra.me' opened Profile showing 'This person hasn't set up their profile yet.'; Close shut it

results.title: Invite a friend by email
results.checks: Signed in as Seed Reader, Add a friend with an email address reads Send invitation; sending says 'Invitation sent to …' with no Home window, and Sent requests shows the address as Invited by email with Resend and Cancel; Resend says it was sent again; Cancel takes it off. (The invitation calls are answered by the test, so no email goes out; each carries the reader's sign-in)
results.note: 'flow-215708@example.org': Invitation sent; listed as Invited by email; Resend said sent again; Cancel took it off; no Home window
